title: Require provenance on every trace envelope
narrative: Nubble rejects incomplete traces that omit config fingerprint, routing, context provenance, or capability envelope refs so offline archaeology can reconstruct the decision path. Accepts WalkingLabs L11 and DeepSeek guidance[^wl-l11-trace][^wl-deepseek-trace].
implementation: `TraceEnvelope`, `envelope_complete`, and `require_trace_envelope` in `mechaharness.trace_envelope` define required provenance fields for run/node events.
validation: Kind `trace_envelope_complete`. Soft expects complete true and no missing fields.
